body:
### Summary

Motivation:

The proliferation of powerful LLM coding agents makes security issues and their fixes more frequent. ruff should do more to help maintainers keep their applications safe.

Need:

I want to use `uv audit` to find CVEs that have fixes available upstream in order to upgrade those packages.

Workaround:

I can manually ignore individual packages using uv's `ignore-until-fixed` setting, which works but is laborious.

Alignment:

There is `ruff check --select=ALL` that selects all rules.

Proposal:

Add a magic package name `ALL` to `ignore-until-fixed`, that automatically selects all packages without a fix.

### Example

$ ruff audit --ignore-until-fixed=ALL
<Shows only such packages that have CVEs fixed upstream and should thus be updated next.>
title: uv audit --ignore-until-fixed=ALL
